what: committed staging case_spec.json no longer matches the bytes the independent review pinned
cause: tests/test_prop_geom_audit_contract.py::setUpClass called audit.config(DEFAULT_JOB_DIR), whose config() copies the CURRENT CaseSpec into the module STAGING directory; repeated test runs therefore rewrote the committed reviewed staging and the drifted bytes were committed. Fixed 2026-10-31: the test now generates into a temporary directory (work/) and never writes the reviewed staging.
executed_evidence_consistent: the executed run used the REVIEWED bytes: run.json records EXECUTION_COMPLETED, staging/config.json pins 033714ff..., staging/review.json pins 033714ff...; the drift is post-review bytes.
restore_possible: NO: the reviewed bytes are not present in git history (only two commits touch the file and neither matches); the historical staging is therefore kept as-is and marked drifted, never re-run or re-pinned.
disposition: staging is HISTORICAL and READ-ONLY; its executed run records remain the evidence; it must not be re-prepared or re-used for a submission. New runs use a fresh run_id.
